ideas.title: Cheat Corpus and Midpoint Foreign-Tool Injection

sleeper_origin.mechanism: Mined 129 distinct failed and foreign tool shapes (782 calls across 10 Sleeper seat tools) from gemini-3.5-flash transcripts and injected each at ticks // 2 to verify zero reward lift or state corruption.

canary_v14_counterpart.mechanism: Ports shape() normalization and midpoint SolverPolicy injection (inject_run), paired with the 33-probe x 3-tier anti-cheat battery (garbage_args, control_solver_then_pad, solver_plus_*) and Harbor cheat_probe (149 out-of-band checks).

canary_v15_counterpart.mechanism: Identical 13-tool _SPECS allowlist and _check_args schema gate; make hunt TIER=all TV=v1.5-candidate recorded 0 invariant violations and 0.000 best non-solver score across easy, medium, hard, and hard_forge.

ideas.one_agent_adaptation_rationale: One-agent Canary has 13 security-lead MCP tools rather than 8 seat-specific operational queues; foreign seat actions (pay, quarantine, report_insider, send_email) become strict schema-rejection invariants that consume 1 global cap slot with zero V or daily-budget side effects.

fairness_invariants.name: corpus_schema_always_invalid
fairness_invariants.detail: All 129 Sleeper foreign-tool patterns in data/redteam/corpus.jsonl are unconditionally rejected by Env._dispatch / _check_args.

fairness_invariants.name: midpoint_injection_zero_perturbation
fairness_invariants.detail: Injecting foreign Sleeper calls at SolverPolicy midpoint changes 0/1161 committed runs and 0/13 live spot-check runs, preserving V, day, and daily action budget.

fairness_invariants.name: anticheat_battery_and_pad_invariance
fairness_invariants.detail: All 42 attack probe x tier cells score <= 0.0 and control_solver_then_pad matches solver to 0.0 across all tiers.

catchability_invariants.name: solver_dominates_all_attack_and_effort_probes
catchability_invariants.detail: SolverPolicy achieves +0.765 / +0.671 / +0.545 on the 40 judge seeds, strictly above every attack probe (<= 0.0) and the 90% effort cut (+0.051 on hard).

ideas.title: Multi-Employee Social Chains, Framing, and Human-Bias Layer

sleeper_origin.mechanism: 8-seat company (CEO assistant, Finance AP, Controller, HR, IT admin, Procurement, Sales, Legal) with 30 multi-seat strategies requiring two-person sign-offs, chat persuasion, and colleague framing.

canary_v14_counterpart.mechanism: Distills multi-seat social dynamics into pure deterministic one-agent mechanics: 2-department regular docs (p_single_dept_recipients=0.0), vocal innocent decoy (dept-channel anger), Poisson + Mole DSL after-hours framing (framing_rate=2.0 on hard), and guarded HR interviews grounded in 44 sourced corporate failure cases.

canary_v15_counterpart.mechanism: Added endogenous one-agent social chatter (rumour_rate=2.0, rumour_frame_share=0.4 seeded at decoy -> LR=1.0, grudge_pairs=2, authority_day=3, p_misforward=0.15, DSL seed_rumour). Trapped rumour_follower at -0.995 (n=400), but OpenCode gemini-4-carbon jumped from 61% to 108% of solver on hard seeds 0..9 (0.664 vs 0.615), so v1.5 was dropped at Gate B.

ideas.one_agent_adaptation_rationale: Running 7 LLM background staff seats confounded benchmark difficulty with staff prompt versions and spent API quota outside the judged agent; encoding decoy chatter, framing, and multi-dept cohorts directly in Env keeps episodes 100% deterministic and keyless while testing social red-herring resistance.

fairness_invariants.name: public_day_facts_mole_independence_and_lint
fairness_invariants.detail: PublicDayFacts has zero mole fields; counterfactually swapping _world.mole changes 0/60 day message batches and produces 0 lint violations.

fairness_invariants.name: decoy_strictly_innocent_and_non_exploitable
fairness_invariants.detail: On medium and hard, decoy != mole on 60/60 seeds and accuse_decoy scores -1.000 across all 40 judge seeds.

catchability_invariants.name: forge_and_rl_mole_catchability_floor
catchability_invariants.detail: Adversarial Mole DSL (hard_forge) and RL mole (hard_rl) enforce solver_acc >= 0.75; held-out RL mole n=100 keeps solver at 0.75 acc (+0.3954 score) while pushing grok_tactics to +0.1643 and heuristic to -0.2942.

ideas.title: Surface-Tells Audit, Known-V Non-Disclosure, and Fair-Bar Bounds

sleeper_origin.mechanism: Sleeper v2 (e08b62ff) replaced legit tickets of matching (seat, kind, payment size), normalized FI IBANs/amounts/V01-V03 payees, and shuffled same-tick messages after wording-list (1.000) and ticket-counting (0.95) agents exploited v1 surface tells.

canary_v14_counterpart.mechanism: Generates all employee names, departments, roles, and clearances before drawing decoy and mole; hides unsurfaced leak drops via KNOWN_V_MODE=True; sets hard log_rate_mole=log_rate_benign=1.0; enforces mole-vs-innocent error/detail parity (1bc3e281); and bounds text-only guessing by exact binomial fair_bar(tier, k).

canary_v15_counterpart.mechanism: Samples unseeded rumour and authority targets uniformly over all non-speaker employees (including the mole) and grudge pairs over all non-decoy employees so being targeted never acts as an innocence exclusion tell; strips forbidden confession phrases.

ideas.one_agent_adaptation_rationale: Instead of ticket-text templates across 8 seats, Canary eliminates every non-investigative shortcut (roster order, log-volume spikes, same-day V drops, error strings, and message leaks) so only active canary partitioning + Bayesian delay accounting separates the mole.

fairness_invariants.name: instruction_completeness_and_tool_smoke
fairness_invariants.detail: Every TierParams field (34/34 per tier) is printed in Env.instruction() and all 13 MCP tools pass smoke checks on easy, medium, and hard (39/39).

fairness_invariants.name: mole_vs_innocent_error_and_accuse_parity
fairness_invariants.detail: Invalid-argument errors, Panel Fix D detail strings (modulo echoed employee id), and accuse() responses are identical for the true mole and innocent peers.

fairness_invariants.name: known_v_hides_unsurfaced_leaks_and_log_counts_carry_zero_hard_signal
fairness_invariants.detail: status and advance_day expose visible_V only (0 unsurfaced leak disclosures), and hard-tier total access counts carry zero signal (log_rate 1.0 vs 1.0; accuse_most_logs = -1.000).

catchability_invariants.name: solver_catchability_without_surface_tells
catchability_invariants.detail: Without any roster, wording, count, or V-drop surface tells, SolverPolicy reaches 96.5% accuracy when accusing on hard (mean +0.564, n=400) and 100.0% on medium (+0.628, n=400).

ideas.title: Failure Gallery and Below-Break-Even Accusation Spotlight

sleeper_origin.mechanism: Decomposed multi-seat episode losses into deterministic harm labels (*_on_chat_request, *_without_ticket, false quarantine) with verbatim transcript excerpts in gallery.json and gallery.md.

canary_v14_counterpart.mechanism: Decomposes solver_score - agent_score step-by-step across 295 episodes (196 v1.4, residual 4.4e-16) and audits all 30 judged v1.4 hard seeds against the moving optimal-stopping bar P*(V) = 1 / (1 + V), isolating negative-EV horizon gambles masked by coin-flip luck.

canary_v15_counterpart.mechanism: Applies canary.analysis.accuse and canary.analysis.tags to the 10-seed v1.5-candidate OpenCode gemini-4-carbon spot-check (accuse.md, tags.json) under identical Bayesian posterior accounting.

ideas.one_agent_adaptation_rationale: In Canary's continuous-value single-accusation stopping game, the dominant frontier mistake is committing with >= 2 consistent suspects or gambling below P*(V) = 1 / (1 + V) as V drains toward 0 rather than abstaining for 0.00.

fairness_invariants.name: exact_additive_gap_accounting_zero_residual
fairness_invariants.detail: Both the 295-episode failure gallery (+90.795 net gap) and the 30-seed v1.4 hard break-even spotlight (+4.1897 luck-adjusted / +5.3000 raw gap) sum with zero unexplained residual (< 1e-12).

fairness_invariants.name: public_evidence_posterior_and_verbatim_quotes
fairness_invariants.detail: Posteriors use only the agent's own public tool history; moving P*(V)=1/(1+V) catches seeds 5, 18, 23 even on visible V_known, including seed 18 (62.72% vs 68.43%) missed by fixed 0.60 cutoffs.

catchability_invariants.name: solver_zero_below_breakeven_stopping_discipline
catchability_invariants.detail: On the exact same 30 v1.4 hard seeds, SolverPolicy makes 0/30 below-break-even accusations (tightest margin +11.60 pp on seed 10), vs 3 for gemini-4-carbon (-0.9348 V EV) and 10 for gemini-3.5-flash (-7.0172 V EV).

ideas.title: Office Replay Dashboard, Side-by-Side CLI, and Browser Case-File Game

sleeper_origin.mechanism: Rendered static seat-mode office replays (highlighting the judged seat, background staff chatter, ticket state, and exact harm tick) alongside offline action_replay verification.

canary_v14_counterpart.mechanism: Splits office replay into three zero-key surfaces: (1) scripts/demo_replay.py day-by-day solver-vs-agent V and P(mole) trace with --verify Env re-execution, (2) game/ Pyodide case-file UI with P*(V)=1/(1+V) accuse dialog on seeds 3000..9999, and (3) self-contained results/gemini/dashboard.html + lab_replay step-hash verification.

canary_v15_counterpart.mechanism: Added scripts/with_tiers.py + scripts/verify_replay.py verification confirming 10/10 v1.5-candidate episodes replay identically under v1.5 rules (and only 6/10 under v1.4, proving social misforwards/messages actively alter trajectories).

ideas.one_agent_adaptation_rationale: With one investigator instead of 8 concurrent staff seats, the critical replay view is the side-by-side belief trajectory P(mole | observations) and visible_V decay between SolverPolicy and the frontier model on the exact same seed.

fairness_invariants.name: browser_game_seed_hygiene_and_truth_hiding
fairness_invariants.detail: game/canary_game.py restricts browser play to public dev seeds 3000..9999 (refusing headline 0..29, train, held-out, and judge seeds), makes 0 hidden tool calls, and blocks reveal_json() until episode end.

fairness_invariants.name: dashboard_secret_redaction_and_self_contained_offline_html
fairness_invariants.detail: canary/gemini/dashboard.py redacts key-shaped substrings, embeds zero external HTTP script/style/image URLs in dashboard.html, and pairs with keyless lab_replay step-hash stores.

catchability_invariants.name: deterministic_replay_and_pyodide_solver_parity
catchability_invariants.detail: demo_replay + verify_replay reproduce solver and Gemini step-for-step on hard seeds 4, 18, and 26 (solver +0.73, +0.52, +0.69), and canary_game.py matches CPython SolverPolicy on seed 3000 (+0.79, 48 calls, day 6).

ideas.title: Salted Judge Worlds, 0600 Secret Isolation, and Signed-Ledger Rescore

sleeper_origin.mechanism: Moved SLEEPER_SALT and VERIFY_TOKEN into 0600 files inside a separate sidecar container, wiped /proc/*/environ secrets, and rejected unsigned or forged state payloads.

canary_v14_counterpart.mechanism: Keys judge/held-out worlds with HMAC-SHA256 fail-closed secrets, loads MCP secrets from 0600 CANARY_*_FILE paths, isolates canary-server in a separate Harbor PID/fs namespace (11/11 isolation checks), and HMAC-signs /ledger.

canary_v15_counterpart.mechanism: Preserved identical HMAC world seeding and kept judge worlds uncached (SHA-256 text cache keyed without world truth).

ideas.one_agent_adaptation_rationale: Because Canary is a pure deductive game with a single hidden mole id, white-box seed regeneration or /proc environ inspection would yield an instant day-1 1.00 score without salted judge worlds and sidecar isolation.

fairness_invariants.name: hmac_salted_judge_worlds_and_public_dev_reproducibility
fairness_invariants.detail: Judge and held-out worlds derive RNG via HMAC-SHA256(secret, tier:seed) and fail closed without a secret, while dev seeds stay public-keyed for exact offline replay.

fairness_invariants.name: signed_ledger_tamper_rejection_and_harbor_consistency
fairness_invariants.detail: Forging score=1.0 after signing fails closed to reward 0 ('bad ledger signature'); 80/80 Harbor trials, 18/18 jobs, and 1021/1021 replayable episodes (51,814 steps) verify cleanly.

catchability_invariants.name: harbor_oracle_and_cheat_probe_separation
catchability_invariants.detail: Inside the isolated Harbor sidecar architecture, SolverPolicy (oracle) scores positively on signed ledgers while do_nothing and 149-attempt cheat_probe score 0.0.

ideas.title: Scripted Attack Library and Winnability Gate to Mole DSL and RL Mole

sleeper_origin.mechanism: Curated scripted sleeper strategies (slow-burn, decoy framing, accomplice gates) filtered by winnable=true so the reference/oracle team could still achieve reward=1.000.

canary_v14_counterpart.mechanism: Replaces seat-specific scripts with a safe 10-feature JSON Mole DSL (hard_forge) and an MLP REINFORCE + dual-ascent Lagrangian policy (hard_rl) sharing the exact (leak_selector, frame_selector) action space under solver_acc >= 0.75.

canary_v15_counterpart.mechanism: Extended Mole DSL with optional seed_rumour framing selector while preserving MoleView's strict canary-blindness and >= 0.85 solver calibration target.

ideas.one_agent_adaptation_rationale: A mole that simply stops leaking makes catchability impossible, while an unconstrained RL mole collapses game fairness; bounding the mole to MoleView (no canary visibility) plus a >= 0.75 SolverPolicy accuracy floor guarantees every adversarial track remains solvable.

fairness_invariants.name: mole_view_information_barrier_and_dsl_determinism
fairness_invariants.detail: MoleView exposes document recipient_count and age_days but never is_canary or variant labels; custom MoleStrategy and RLMole execute deterministically from the world RNG without arbitrary code execution.

catchability_invariants.name: stackelberg_lagrangian_catchability_constraint
catchability_invariants.detail: Replacing Sleeper's binary winnable=true filter, Canary's Lagrangian RL mole maximizes solver_score - max_k score_k subject to solver_acc >= 0.75, widening regret on held-out seeds 200000..200099 while preserving 75% solver catchability.
